candidates.spoken: The SL-1 reactor exploded during maintenance.
A small military reactor in Idaho exploded during maintenance.
They were reconnecting its central control rod.
That rod had to be lifted by hand.
It was pulled far too high.
The reactor went critical and flashed water to steam.
The blast lifted the reactor vessel off its mounts.
prompt criticality from manual withdrawal of the central control rod.
a single control rod pulled out too far by hand.
It started with maintenance requires lifting a rod. It ended with vessel jumps upward.

script.spoken: The SL-1 reactor exploded during maintenance. In an instant, all three men working on it were killed. They were reconnecting its central control rod. That rod had to be lifted by hand. It was pulled far too high. The reactor went critical and flashed water to steam. The blast lifted the reactor vessel off its mounts. Reactors were then designed so no single rod can do this.
